description: Gujarat Natural Resources Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration of oil and natural gas in India. The company holds interests in 6 producing blocks, including five operated blocks in the Cambay basin. It also provides well engineering and drilling project management services. In addition, the company engages in the trading of goods; and other activities. The company was formerly known as Lesha Energy Resources Limited and changed its name to Gujarat Natural Resources Limited in March 2010. Gujarat Natural Resources Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
